result.reason: The clause largely tracks the preferred position on six months of transition assistance, then-current rates, machine-readable return, and certified deletion. However, it measures the 30-day data-return period from Customer's request rather than from expiry or termination, so a timely export is not assured. It also requires return and deletion of all Customer data upon termination of any single Service Option Attachment, potentially disrupting continuing attachments and conflicting with the preserved intent that termination of one attachment does not affect others. The provision should distinguish full Agreement termination from attachment-level termination and limit the latter to data associated with the terminated attachment.
